purpose: Smallest independent three-ticker expansion for completed reverse splits, active listing deficiency, going concern, foreign-filer/IFRS, and OTC/delisted coverage.
approval_required: A new owner approval must freeze this proposal before any live execution. This file contains no approval token and is not executable.

evaluation_rules.independence: BIOR, MULN, NIO, and TUPBQ remain historical controls and are not run.
evaluation_rules.answer_key: Adjudicate only against the primary-source facts below; never revise them to match Fast output.
evaluation_rules.nio_clarification: Prospectively classify NIO attributable annual net loss as unavailable_authoritative_evidence when bounded authoritative retrieval completes, no safe Company Facts concept or implemented SEC table fallback exists, and the report settles Limited/Unscored. Historical measurements and answer keys remain unchanged.
evaluation_rules.gate: Approximately 95% overall material-risk recall, approximately 90% for every adequately sampled critical category, and zero unresolved severe misleading misses.
evaluation_rules.sampling_guardrail: Three additional cases improve mechanism diversity but do not establish statistical reliability. Foreign/IFRS and active-deficiency coverage remain sparse after this batch.

cases.identity: Rekor Systems, Inc. common stock, Nasdaq Capital Market ticker REKR, CIK 1697851; domestic Delaware issuer.
cases.current_listing_status: Nasdaq-listed with an active minimum-bid-price deficiency disclosed April 27, 2026; the June 30, 2026 Form 10-Q says the compliance period runs through October 26, 2026.
known_material_facts: The April 27, 2026 Nasdaq notice establishes an active Rule 5550(a)(2) minimum-bid deficiency, not a delisting and not restored compliance.
The June 30, 2026 Form 10-Q says REKR remained Nasdaq-listed and had until October 26, 2026 to regain bid-price compliance.

The June 30, 2026 Form 10-Q reports substantial doubt about going concern, a $6.598 million working-capital deficit, $9.8 million cash, and $15.0 million of Series A Prime Revenue Sharing Notes due December 15, 2026.
A possible future reverse split is a cure option only; it is not a completed historical split.
legitimately_limited: non-SEC catalyst context when optional discovery is unavailable
severe_miss_conditions: Active Nasdaq deficiency is omitted, described as resolved, or converted to an OTC/delisted state.
The going-concern conclusion or immediate liquidity/debt pressure is omitted or made favorable.
A proposed cure reverse split is presented as completed.

cases.identity: Zapp Electric Vehicles Group Limited ordinary shares, OTC ticker ZAPPF, CIK 1955104; Cayman Islands foreign private issuer using Form 20-F/6-K and IFRS.
cases.current_listing_status: Nasdaq suspended/delisted the former ZAPP ordinary shares effective May 20, 2025; SEC's current entity page identifies ZAPPF on OTC.
known_material_facts: ZAPPF represents Cayman Islands ordinary shares, not a U.S. domestic common stock and not an ADR; the issuer files 20-F/6-K and reports under IFRS.
A 1-for-20 reverse split became effective April 22, 2024 and split-adjusted trading began April 23, 2024.
Nasdaq suspended/delisted the former ZAPP securities effective May 20, 2025 for minimum-bid and market-value noncompliance; SEC now identifies ZAPPF on OTC.
The September 30, 2024 20-F reports a net loss, negative operating cash flow, $1.6 million cash, $20.7 million trade and other payables, and material going-concern dependence on additional capital.
The fiscal-2025 Form 20-F was reported late on Form NT 20-F in January 2026, so stale or unavailable newer financial trends must remain Limited.
legitimately_limited: precise OTC tier beyond the SEC current ticker identity
secondary news when optional discovery is unavailable
severe_miss_conditions: Wrong security type, domestic filing regime, currency, cadence, or accounting basis is used.
The completed 1-for-20 split or Nasdaq delisting is omitted or described as merely proposed.
Stale 2024 financials create favorable scores despite the late 2025 annual filing and going-concern evidence.
Former Nasdaq ticker ZAPP is presented as currently Nasdaq-listed.

cases.identity: Esports Entertainment Group, Inc. common stock, OTC ticker GMBL, CIK 1451448; Nevada domestic issuer with principal operations/address historically in Malta.
cases.current_listing_status: Nasdaq trading was suspended February 21, 2024 after voluntary delisting; the filed issuer release said the securities would initially quote on OTC Pink and seek OTCQB.
known_material_facts: GMBL is a Nevada domestic issuer, not a foreign private issuer merely because its principal address was in Malta.
A completed 1-for-100 reverse split became split-adjusted February 22, 2023 and a completed 1-for-400 reverse split became effective December 22, 2023.
Nasdaq trading was suspended February 21, 2024 following voluntary delisting, with issuer-disclosed migration to OTC quotation.
The bounded record contains repeated listing pressure, preferred-stock/financing obligations, and going-concern risk; missing post-deregistration financial detail must not become favorable.
legitimately_limited: exact current OTC tier if no current market-operator record is retrieved
severe_miss_conditions: GMBL is represented as currently Nasdaq-listed or as a foreign private issuer.
Either 2023 completed reverse split is omitted, duplicated, or given the wrong effective date/ratio.
Missing post-deregistration financial evidence becomes a favorable score.
Voluntary delisting is misclassified as an active curable Nasdaq deficiency.

sample_size_map.note: Mechanism diversity improves, but five cases are not a statistical reliability claim.
Two issuers remain too few for a category-level reliability claim.
Includes bankruptcy plus three going-concern shapes; still a small calibration sample.
Adds ordinary-share/OTC/IFRS diversity but no second new ADR or 40-F case.
Covers current OTC identity after involuntary and voluntary Nasdaq exits; precise tier may remain Limited.
